chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect; linked causal variant or passenger
predictions: No reproducible allele-specific TF binding is seen at rs13078086.
LPP expression is not associated with rs13078086 genotype after controlling for linked variants.
Perturbing the local element does not produce an allele-dependent LPP or colorectal cancer phenotype.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific TF binding effect and allele-dependent LPP expression are demonstrated at rs13078086.

chains.title: Alt G strengthens a TCF7L2 site in a 3q28 enhancer and raises LPP

links.claim: The alt G allele at rs13078086 is predicted to bind TCF7L2 more strongly than the ref T allele.
The variant lies in a cis-regulatory enhancer at 3q28 near LPP.
Stronger TCF7L2 binding at this element increases LPP transcription.
HCT116 cells have active Wnt/TCF7L2 signaling and express LPP.
Increased LPP expression promotes colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: Allele-specific TCF7L2 binding assays in HCT116 nuclear extract show G > T binding at rs13078086.
The G allele increases enhancer reporter activity and LPP expression in colorectal cells.
CRISPRi of the 3q28 element reduces LPP expression in HCT116.
falsified_if: No reproducible allele-specific TCF7L2 binding is seen at rs13078086.
The variant does not affect LPP expression or enhancer activity in colorectal cells.

chains.title: Ref T strengthens a CDX2 site in the same 3q28 element and raises LPP

links.claim: The ref T allele at rs13078086 is predicted to bind CDX2 more strongly than the alt G allele.
The variant lies in an intestinal enhancer at 3q28 near LPP.
CDX2 binding at this element increases LPP transcription.
HCT116 is a colorectal cell line with CDX2 expression.
Altered LPP expression changes colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: Allele-specific CDX2 binding shows T > G at rs13078086.
The T allele increases enhancer reporter activity, and CDX2 knockdown reduces LPP.
The effect is attenuated by CDX2 depletion but not by TCF7L2 depletion.
falsified_if: CDX2 binding is not allele-specific at this variant.
CDX2 knockdown does not change LPP expression from this element.

chains.title: Alt G strengthens an HNF4A site that represses LPP

links.claim: The alt G allele at rs13078086 is predicted to bind HNF4A more strongly than the ref T allele.
The variant lies in a regulatory element at 3q28 near LPP.
Stronger HNF4A binding represses LPP transcription.
HCT116 cells express HNF4A and use it in colorectal regulatory programs.
Reduced LPP expression modifies colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: Allele-specific HNF4A binding shows G > T at rs13078086.
The G allele reduces LPP expression in reporter and endogenous assays.
falsified_if: HNF4A binding is not allele-specific at this variant.
The G allele does not reduce LPP expression, or HNF4A knockdown does not increase LPP.

next_experiment: Cheapest discriminating test: allele-specific EMSA or oligo pull-down with HCT116 nuclear extract and anti-TCF7L2, comparing ref-T and alt-G probes at rs13078086; a G-specific TCF7L2 shift supports H1, while no reproducible allele difference supports the null.
